# konnect_catalog_ai_model_version_spec (Resource)

CatalogAiModelVersionSpec Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_catalog_ai_model_version_spec" "my_catalogaimodelversionspec" {
  ai_model_id  = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
  spec_content = "{\"openapi\":\"3.1.0\",\"info\":{\"title\":\"My AI Model\",\"version\":\"1.0.0\"},\"paths\":{}}"
  spec_provider = {
    source = "ai_gateway"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ai_model_id` (String) The unique identifier of the AI Model.
- `spec_content` (String) The raw content of the oas specification, in json or yaml format (for example, an
OpenAPI document).

### Optional

- `spec_provider` (Attributes) Optional provenance. Omit (or `null`) for a user-uploaded specification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec_provider))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `spec_type` (String) The type of specification document. Currently always `oas` (OpenAPI Specification).
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

<a id="nestedatt--spec_provider"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec_provider`

Required:

- `source` (String) possible known values include one of ["ai_gateway", "provider"]

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_catalog_ai_model_version_spec.my_konnect_catalog_ai_model_version_spec
  id = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_catalog_ai_model_version_spec.my_konnect_catalog_ai_model_version_spec "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
```
